title: Hadrians Wall
description: A 100m length of the turf-vcovered remains of Hadrians Wall between NY7375 6732 and NY 7381 6740 is the one section between Cawfield quarry and Black Dyke not on NT lands. There is some Wall core material to the N of a field wall which probably occupies the S face of Hadrians Wall. About 1.5m from the N face of the field wall is a distinct robber trench and there is some evidence of possible of original Roman foundations.
creator: National Trust
subject: not provided
